summary: Boundary County lookout: 1932 log cabin, 1934 40-foot L-4 tower; cabin moved 1970, tower removed 1977; site is now a trailhead with a footing.

facts.status_note: The tower came down in 1977; the site is now a trailhead with a footing and a parking area.

access.note: Described as a popular trailhead for Selkirk peaks; no closure mentioned. Higher-clearance vehicle needed for the final half mile.

visit.trail_note: Lower-clearance cars park at the saddle about half a mile below the site

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1932 cabin, 1934 tower, 1970 cabin move and 1977 removal. The 6,091 ft elevation appears on Idaho Fire Lookouts (6091') and Willhite (6,091 feet). The Idaho Fire Lookouts tag 'Drive-Up Removed' may mean the lookout is removed rather than the road being closed, so drive_up true rests on Willhite's 'Hiking Distance: Drive-up' line; please check. The footing and parking area come from Willhite's photo captions, which are undated. Access level 'public' is an inference from the trailhead description, not a stated rule. The brief's gone status and tower kind hold; design was null in the record and is filled from firelookout.com. Staffing is not documented by any source and is left out. Used 2 searches and about 5 page reads. Checked 2026-10-10: Willhite's page has no closure wording, so the Idaho Fire Lookouts 'Drive-Up Removed' tag is still unexplained.
